Performers
Sergei Rachmaninoff (piano), Philadelphia Orchestra (orchestra), Leopold Stokowski (conductor) Documented

The HMV label uses Philadelphia Symphony Orchestra; DAHR identifies the ensemble as the Philadelphia Orchestra.

[2] [3]
Work version
Unknown Unknown

The performing edition is not identified. This file is the complete transfer of the first original side, not a complete movement and not a reconstruction from joined sides. The HMV label calls the movement Allegro moderato; DAHR gives Moderato.

[1] [3]
Recorded
10 April 1929 Documented

DAHR identifies take 3 as the issued master. The Archive’s 1930 date describes the issued record, not this session.

[3]
Place
Academy of Music, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania Documented

The matrix’s Take Date and Place table names the Academy of Music. Camden in the issue’s MARC publisher imprint is not adopted as a recording venue.

[3]
Label
His Master’s Voice / The Gramophone Co. Ltd. Documented

UK 12-inch 78-rpm pressing, manufactured at Hayes, Middlesex, England according to the label.

[2] [1]
Catalogue
D.B. 1333 Documented

First side of the first movement; the label marks it No. 1 and 1st Record. Internet Archive dates the issue to 1930; DAHR’s generated MARC imprint gives [1929]. Publication was therefore documented well before 1963, without resolving the precise first issue date.

[2] [4]
Matrix, take, sides
Victor CVE-48963, take 3; Gramophone face number 42-600; concerto part 1 Documented

DAHR connects the master take to DB-1333 and distinguishes 42-600 as a Gramophone face number. The Archive transcribes A48963 as another disc identifier; it is not treated as a separate performance or take.

[2] [1] [3] [4]
Transfer
Phoebe Pugh, transfer and metadata; Akin Gaddis, disc cleaning; George Blood, L.P., digitisation Documented

Credits are the Archive’s user_transferred, user_metadataentered, user_cleaned and scanningcenter fields. The carrier belongs to the Leif Druedahl collection.

[1]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

The item was made public on 19 April 2023; this is an upload date, not a documented transfer date.

[1]
Processing
Digitised at 78 rpm; preferred 3.3-mil truncated-conical stylus transfer, equalised with turnover 500.0; 24-bit FLAC master and VBR MP3 access derivative. Documented

The Archive documents four stylus transfers and identifies the chosen stylus in the preferred FLAC comment. Technical notes report minor distortion and some wow/pitch warble. No additional restoration or speed correction has been applied for this edition; measured pitch-class or attack estimates must not be read as reliable tuning or ornament counts.

[1]
Composition rights
Public domain in ordinary life-plus-70 jurisdictions. Inferred, not documented

Rachmaninoff died on 28 March 1943. This concerns the composition, not the separately assessed recording, transfer or an unidentified modern edition.

[5] [6]
Recording rights
Territorial EU public-domain basis: sound recording published before 1963. Documented

Rule 3. The HMV DB-1333 issue is dated 1930 by the Archive and [1929] in DAHR’s MARC imprint; 1930 is the conservative documented publication bound used in source.rights. Its former 50-year recording term expired before the 2013 extension, which applies to recordings still protected on 1 November 2013. US public-domain status is not established. This independent George Blood transfer has no licenceurl or non-commercial condition in the consulted item metadata and identifies its own original FLAC and physical carrier. F. Reeder’s separate RACHMANINOFFPianoConcertoNo.2InCMinor-NEWTRANSFER carries CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 and is expressly excluded, not an upstream source for this audio. This is a territorial recording-term assessment, not a worldwide licence or a claim that the modern transfer has been freely licensed.

Sergei Rachmaninoff, piano; Philadelphia Orchestra; Leopold Stokowski, conductor. Recorded 10 April 1929. HMV D.B. 1333, opening side only; Leif Druedahl collection, digitised by George Blood, L.P., via Internet Archive. Territorial EU public-domain recording basis; US status not established.
